ABOUT

HireFlow AI is a B2B SaaS platform in the recruitment & talent acquisition domain, focused on candidate screening, hiring analytics, and operational workflows.

OVERVIEW

HireFlow AI is an end-to-end recruitment platform that unifies candidate sourcing, AI-powered resume screening, interview scheduling, and hiring analytics into a single intelligent system built for modern HR teams.

As a solo designer, I led the entire product experience from scratch - from UX research and information architecture to UI design and a scalable design system that keeps every data-dense screen consistent.

USER RESEARCH

User research was conducted with professionals in talent acquisition to understand their workflows, challenges, and decision-making needs.

Laura, 28y

Associate Manager, HR

“I manage 10+ open roles at a time. I need tools that eliminate busywork so I can focus on building relationships with candidates.”

Mayur, 32y

Manager, HR

“As a manager, I need real-time visibility into my open roles. Waiting days for recruiter updates kills our momentum.”

Mathew, 47y

Senior Manager, RMG

“I need to see the big picture - hiring velocity, team performance, and diversity metrics - to make strategic talent decisions.”

USER PERSONA

Recruiters work with high volumes of candidates across fragmented tools as part of their daily hiring workflow.

Motivations

  • Screen hundreds of applicants faster without sacrificing quality
  • Keep top candidates warm and engaged throughout the process
  • Reclaim time for relationship-building over repetitive admin

Pain points

  • Manually reviewing 200+ resumes per role consumes most of the workday
  • Juggling 5 disconnected tools - Greenhouse, Slack, LinkedIn, email, sheets
  • Slow follow-ups cause strong candidates to accept other offers first

User needs

  • AI resume screening that auto-ranks candidates by fit and skills
  • A single platform covering sourcing, screening, and scheduling
  • Automated candidate communication to eliminate manual follow-ups
KEY INSIGHTS

Research revealed how recruiters navigate disconnected systems, uncovering critical workflow gaps and decision bottlenecks.

INSIGHTS60%

INSIGHTS52%

INSIGHTS40%

PROBLEM & SOLUTION

Unifying disconnected hiring workflows through intelligent product design.

Problem 1

Recruitment teams operate across email, spreadsheets, calendars, and multiple point solutions without a unified workflow - creating manual handoffs, longer hiring cycles averaging 42 days, and no real-time visibility into pipeline health.

Problem 2

Recruiters spend 60% of their time on administrative tasks, leaving little room to engage candidates meaningfully. With no centralised system, 52% of top candidates abandon the process due to slow response times and poor communication.

Solution

HireFlow AI consolidates sourcing, AI screening, interview scheduling, and hiring analytics into a single intelligent platform - eliminating manual effort, accelerating decisions, and giving every stakeholder real-time visibility into the talent pipeline.

DESIGN PRINCIPLES

Three principles behind HireFlow AI

1

Simplify without stripping power

Recruitment is data-dense by nature. The goal was to surface the right information at the right moment - not reduce it.

2

Build a system, not only screens

A shared design language keeps decisions consistent across the product.

3

Make AI feel like a collaborator

Showing confidence scores alongside human controls built trust - recruiters felt empowered, not replaced.

UI SOLUTION

The Complete HireFlow AI Experience

Dashboard

Problem: Recruiters struggle to track hiring activities across multiple tools.
Solution: Centralized dashboard with AI insights and real-time metrics.
Impact: Improved visibility and reduced context switching.

Candidate Pipeline

Problem: Candidate progress is difficult to track across hiring stages.
Solution: Kanban-based pipeline with AI-assisted candidate insights.
Impact: Faster candidate management and better pipeline visibility.

AI Resume Screening

Problem: Recruiters spend significant time manually reviewing resumes to identify qualified candidates.
Solution: AI-powered screening analyzes skills, experience, and role fit to automatically prioritize top candidates.
Impact: Reduced screening time and accelerated candidate shortlisting.

Candidate Detail

Problem: Candidate information is often scattered across multiple systems.
Solution: Unified profile combining experience, skills, feedback, and AI recommendations.
Impact: Quicker evaluations and informed hiring decisions.

Interview Planner

Problem: Coordinating interviews across stakeholders is time-consuming.
Solution: Calendar-driven scheduling with streamlined interview management.
Impact: Reduced scheduling effort and improved coordination.

AI Interview Summary

Problem: Interview feedback is inconsistent and difficult to consolidate.
Solution: AI-generated summaries highlighting key insights and recommendations.
Impact: Faster and more objective hiring decisions.

Hiring Analytics

Problem: Hiring leaders lack actionable visibility into recruitment performance.
Solution: Analytics dashboard focused on hiring outcomes and trends.
Impact: Enabled data-driven decision-making and process optimization.

Settings

Problem: Recruiters struggled to manage AI hiring preferences while ensuring fair and compliant evaluations.
Solution: A centralized settings hub for AI features, bias controls, and compliance management.
Impact: Consistent AI hiring practices with greater transparency and control.

RESULTS & IMPACT

Expected Outcomes

As a solo designer, I focused on solving the core friction points in the recruitment flow. These are the projected improvements based on the redesigned workflows and interface decisions.

31%

Faster Screening

AI-powered resume analysis was designed to reduce average screening time from 15 minutes to roughly 4.5 minutes per candidate.

18%

Reduced Time-to-Hire

Streamlined workflows and automated scheduling aim to cut average time-to-hire from 38 days to around 21 days.

22%

Increase in Productivity

Integrated AI summaries and in-app collaboration tools were built to keep hiring managers engaged throughout the process.

REFLECTION

Looking Back & Forward

HireFlow AI was one of the most complex product design challenges I’ve undertaken. Balancing the needs of recruiters who crave efficiency, hiring managers who need visibility, and HR leaders who require compliance - all within a single cohesive platform - required deep empathy and strategic thinking at every stage.

If I revisit this project, I would invest more time in designing the onboarding experience. A platform this feature-rich needs a thoughtful guided setup to reduce initial cognitive load. I would also explore deeper integrations with existing ATS and HRIS tools that enterprise teams already rely on.
